something: Learning something new every day can help adults remain curious and adapt to changes in the workplace.

fire: Regular safety inspections can reduce the risk of fire in older residential buildings with outdated electrical systems.

当洪水使道路无法供救援车辆安全通行时，救援直升机可以抵达被困的偏远社区。
untidy: Shared workspaces can quickly become untidy unless employees take responsibility for keeping communal areas clean and organised.
如果员工不主动保持公共区域干净有序，共享办公空间很快就会变得凌乱。
soccer: Community soccer clubs provide affordable exercise and help young people develop teamwork skills outside the classroom.
社区足球俱乐部提供费用低廉的锻炼机会，帮助年轻人在课堂之外培养团队协作能力。
boot: Protective boots are essential for construction workers because they reduce the risk of serious foot injuries.
防护靴对建筑工人至关重要，因为它们能降低脚部严重受伤的风险。
ring: Passengers should silence their phones because devices that ring repeatedly can disturb others on public transport.
乘客应将手机调至静音，因为设备反复响铃会打扰公共交通工具上的其他人。
heating: Improving home insulation can reduce heating costs and lower the environmental impact of household energy consumption.
改善住宅保温可以降低供暖费用，并减轻家庭能源消耗对环境的影响。
smoke: Smoke from forest fires can reduce air quality in cities hundreds of kilometres away.
森林火灾产生的烟雾会降低数百公里外城市的空气质量。
recording: Access to a lecture recording allows students to review difficult concepts at their own pace.
能够获取讲座录像，让学生可以按自己的节奏复习难懂的概念。
non-smoking: Non-smoking areas in public buildings help protect visitors and employees from exposure to tobacco smoke.
公共建筑内的禁烟区域有助于保护访客和员工免受烟草烟雾的影响。
postcode: Researchers used postcode data to compare access to public transport across different residential areas.
研究人员利用邮政编码数据，比较不同住宅区的公共交通便利程度。
blonde: Films that repeatedly associate blonde hair with particular personalities can reinforce unfair stereotypes about appearance.
电影若反复将金发与特定性格联系起来，可能会强化对外貌的不公平刻板印象。
lend: Local banks could lend small businesses money to invest in cleaner production methods.
地方银行可以向小企业贷款，帮助它们投资更清洁的生产方式。
sandal: In warm climates, sandals are popular because their open design allows air to circulate around the feet.
在气候温暖的地区，凉鞋很受欢迎，因为其开放式设计能让脚部通风。
interest: Schools can stimulate interest in science by giving students opportunities to conduct experiments and explore practical problems.
学校可以让学生有机会进行实验并探索实际问题，从而激发他们对科学的兴趣。
dead: Leaving dead trees in forests can support biodiversity by providing habitats for insects and small animals.
将枯树留在森林中能为昆虫和小动物提供栖息地，从而促进生物多样性。
duck: Urban parks with healthy ponds provide valuable habitats for ducks and other wildlife throughout the year.
拥有健康池塘的城市公园全年都能为鸭子和其他野生动物提供宝贵的栖息地。
mean: Higher energy prices may mean that low-income households have less money available for other essential needs.
能源价格上涨可能意味着低收入家庭可用于其他基本需求的钱会更少。
dream: Access to affordable education allows more young people to pursue their dream of entering a skilled profession.
负担得起的教育让更多年轻人能够追求从事技术性职业的梦想。
regular: Regular exercise can reduce the risk of chronic disease and improve overall wellbeing in older adults.
规律运动可以降低老年人患慢性病的风险，并改善其整体身心健康。
stairs: Public buildings should provide lifts alongside stairs to ensure equal access for people with limited mobility.
公共建筑应在楼梯之外配备电梯，确保行动不便者也能平等使用。
accept: Governments must accept responsibility for ensuring that all children have access to basic education.
政府必须承担责任，确保所有儿童都能接受基础教育。
abroad: Studying abroad can help students develop independence and gain a better understanding of other cultures.
出国留学能帮助学生培养独立性，并更好地理解其他文化。
attend: Students who attend lectures regularly are more likely to understand difficult concepts and complete assignments successfully.
经常听课的学生更有可能理解难懂的概念并顺利完成作业。
take-away: Restaurants should offer reusable containers to customers who buy meals to take away, reducing packaging waste.
餐馆应为购买外带餐食的顾客提供可重复使用的容器，以减少包装废弃物。
candy: Limiting advertisements for candy aimed at children could help families develop healthier eating habits.
限制面向儿童的糖果广告，可以帮助家庭养成更健康的饮食习惯。
basic: Governments should ensure that all citizens have access to basic healthcare, regardless of their income.
政府应确保所有公民都能获得基本医疗服务，不论其收入如何。
public: Investment in public transport can improve access to employment while reducing dependence on private cars.
投资公共交通可以让人们更方便地上班，同时减少对私家车的依赖。
boarding-card: Passengers can now download a boarding card, reducing paper consumption and waiting times at airport counters.
乘客现在可以下载登机牌，从而减少纸张消耗和在机场柜台的等候时间。
rubbish: Reducing household rubbish requires both convenient recycling facilities and greater public awareness of unnecessary packaging.
减少生活垃圾既需要便利的回收设施，也需要提高公众对过度包装的认识。
restroom: Providing a clean public restroom near busy transport hubs improves comfort for commuters and tourists alike.
在繁忙的交通枢纽附近提供干净的公共洗手间，能让通勤者和游客都更加舒适。
midnight: Extending public transport services beyond midnight would benefit shift workers who currently rely on expensive taxi journeys.
将公共交通服务延长至午夜之后，将有利于目前依赖昂贵出租车出行的轮班工作者。
bar: Sports centres should not bar residents from using essential facilities simply because they cannot afford membership fees.
体育中心不应仅因居民付不起会员费，就禁止他们使用基本设施。
choice: Reliable public transport gives commuters a wider choice and reduces their dependence on private cars.
可靠的公共交通为通勤者提供更多选择，并减少他们对私家车的依赖。
return: Investment in early childhood education can generate a substantial economic return by improving future employment opportunities.
投资幼儿教育可以通过改善未来就业机会，带来可观的经济回报。
properly: Public recycling schemes are more effective when residents understand how to sort household waste properly.
当居民了解如何正确分类生活垃圾时，公共回收计划会更有效。
northwest: Investment in rail networks could improve access to employment for communities in the northwest of the country.
对铁路网的投资可以为该国西北部的社区提供更多就业便利。
runner: Urban parks provide runners with safer exercise spaces away from heavy traffic and polluted main roads.
城市公园为跑步者提供更安全的锻炼空间，远离繁忙交通和污染严重的主干道。
pork: Clear food labelling helps consumers identify products containing pork and make choices that suit their dietary requirements.
清晰的食品标签有助于消费者识别含猪肉的产品，并作出符合自身饮食要求的选择。
drama: Teaching drama in schools can develop students' confidence and encourage them to consider different perspectives.
在学校教授戏剧可以培养学生的自信，并鼓励他们从不同角度思考。
surprise: The survey results may surprise policymakers who assume that young people prefer online learning.
调查结果可能让那些认为年轻人偏爱线上学习的政策制定者感到意外。
case: In many cases, investing in preventive healthcare is more cost-effective than treating diseases after they develop.
在许多情况下，投资预防保健比在疾病出现后进行治疗更具成本效益。
spider: Although many people fear spiders, these creatures help control insect populations in gardens and agricultural environments.
虽然许多人害怕蜘蛛，但它们有助于控制花园和农业环境中的昆虫数量。
pepper: Farmers can grow peppers in greenhouses to maintain a reliable food supply throughout the year.
农民可以在温室里种植甜椒，以维持全年的稳定食物供应。
allow: Flexible working arrangements allow employees to balance their professional responsibilities with family commitments more effectively.
灵活的工作安排使员工能够更有效地兼顾工作职责与家庭义务。
camping: Camping can encourage greater appreciation of nature, provided visitors avoid disturbing wildlife and take their rubbish home.
露营能增进人们对自然的欣赏，前提是游客不打扰野生动物，并把垃圾带走。
ant: Ants contribute to healthy ecosystems by moving seeds and improving the structure of soil.
蚂蚁通过搬运种子和改善土壤结构，促进生态系统健康。
raise: Community events can raise funds for conservation projects while helping residents understand local environmental challenges.
社区活动可以为自然保护项目筹集资金，同时帮助居民了解当地的环境问题。
set: Governments should set clear targets for reducing air pollution and regularly assess progress towards achieving them.
政府应设定明确的空气污染减排目标，并定期评估实现这些目标的进展。
feed: School meal programmes help feed children whose families cannot consistently afford nutritious food.
学校供餐计划帮助那些家庭无法持续负担营养食物的儿童吃上饭。
pancake: Preparing pancakes in cooking classes allows students to practise measuring ingredients and using kitchen equipment safely.
在烹饪课上制作煎饼，让学生有机会练习称量食材和安全使用厨房设备。
except: The proposed transport policy benefits most residents, except those living in remote rural communities.
拟议的交通政策惠及大多数居民，但偏远农村社区的居民除外。
still: Despite improvements in public transport, many commuters still rely on private cars because services remain unreliable in rural areas.
尽管公共交通有所改善，许多通勤者仍依赖私家车，因为农村地区的公共交通服务依然不可靠。
fresh: Access to fresh fruit and vegetables is essential for improving diets in low-income urban communities.
让城市低收入社区居民能获得新鲜果蔬，对改善其饮食至关重要。
comma: A misplaced comma can change the meaning of a sentence and confuse readers of academic writing.
位置不当的逗号可能改变句意，使学术文章的读者产生困惑。
destroy: Uncontrolled urban expansion can destroy natural habitats and threaten the survival of species that depend on them.
不受控制的城市扩张会摧毁自然栖息地，威胁依赖这些栖息地的物种生存。
professor: The professor encouraged students to evaluate different sources before drawing conclusions about climate policy.
这位教授鼓励学生在对气候政策下结论之前评估不同的信息来源。
headphone: Students using headphones in shared study spaces should keep the volume low to protect their hearing.
在公共学习空间使用耳机的学生应保持较低音量，以保护听力。
improve: Investing in teacher training can improve educational outcomes, especially in schools serving disadvantaged communities.
投资教师培训可以改善教育成果，尤其是在服务弱势社区的学校中。
cotton: Cotton production can place considerable pressure on water supplies, particularly in regions with limited rainfall.
棉花生产会给供水带来相当大的压力，尤其是在降雨量有限的地区。
relationship: Researchers are investigating the relationship between access to green spaces and mental health in urban communities.
研究人员正在调查城市社区中绿地的可及性与心理健康之间的关系。
plus: Affordable housing plus reliable public transport can make expanding cities more accessible to workers on modest incomes.
经济适用的住房加上可靠的公共交通，能让收入不高的劳动者更容易在扩张中的城市生活。
jazz: Community jazz festivals can attract visitors while giving local musicians valuable opportunities to perform.
社区爵士音乐节既能吸引游客，也能为当地音乐人提供宝贵的演出机会。
kilogramme: Producing a kilogramme of beef generally requires more water than producing the same weight of vegetables.
生产一公斤牛肉通常比生产同等重量的蔬菜需要更多的水。
onion: Growing onions and other vegetables locally can shorten supply chains and provide communities with fresher produce.
在本地种植洋葱等蔬菜可以缩短供应链，为社区提供更新鲜的农产品。
storm: Coastal communities need stronger flood defences to protect homes and essential services during severe storms.
沿海社区需要更坚固的防洪设施，以在强风暴期间保护住房和基本公共服务。
neighbourhood: Investing in neighbourhood parks can improve residents' health while creating opportunities for people to meet and socialise.
投资建设社区公园可以改善居民健康，同时创造见面和社交的机会。
thin: Thin layers of insulation can improve energy efficiency without significantly reducing the usable space inside buildings.
薄层隔热材料能提高能源效率，同时不会明显减少建筑内部的可用空间。
print: Schools can reduce paper waste by encouraging students to print assignments only when physical copies are necessary.
学校可以鼓励学生仅在需要纸质版时打印作业，以减少纸张浪费。
permission: Researchers must obtain permission from participants before collecting personal information for a scientific study.
研究人员为科学研究收集个人信息前，必须征得参与者同意。
sleepy: Students who feel sleepy during lessons may struggle to concentrate and retain new information effectively.
上课时感到困倦的学生可能难以集中注意力，也难以有效记住新知识。
sick: Paid sick leave allows employees to recover at home and reduces the spread of infections in workplaces.
带薪病假让员工能在家康复，并减少感染在工作场所传播。
straight: Building straight roads across mountainous regions can be expensive and may damage natural habitats.
在山区修建笔直的道路可能成本高昂，还可能破坏自然栖息地。
housework: Sharing housework fairly allows family members to balance paid employment with responsibilities at home more effectively.
公平分担家务可以让家庭成员更有效地平衡有偿工作与家庭责任。
noun: Understanding whether a noun is countable helps language learners choose appropriate articles and express quantities accurately in academic writing.
了解名词是否可数，有助于语言学习者在学术写作中选用合适的冠词并准确表达数量。
tablet: Providing every student with a tablet may improve access to resources, but teachers still need suitable training.
为每名学生配备平板电脑可能有助于获取学习资源，但教师仍需接受适当培训。
toothache: Affordable dental services allow people with toothache to seek treatment before more serious problems develop.
价格可负担的牙科服务让牙痛患者能在问题恶化前就医。
temperature: Rising ocean temperatures can damage coral reefs and threaten the survival of many marine species.
海洋温度上升会破坏珊瑚礁，并威胁许多海洋物种的生存。
enemy: Public distrust can become an enemy of effective environmental policy, particularly when governments fail to explain their decisions.
公众的不信任可能成为有效环境政策的大敌，尤其是在政府未能解释其决策时。
snowboarding: Snowboarding lessons should include safety training so that beginners can share mountain slopes responsibly.
单板滑雪课程应包含安全训练，让初学者能负责任地与他人共用山坡雪道。
skate: Public facilities where children can skate safely encourage physical activity and provide affordable recreation for families.
供儿童安全滑冰的公共设施能鼓励体育活动，并为家庭提供经济实惠的娱乐选择。
point: The main point of this argument is that education should remain accessible to everyone.
这一论证的核心观点是，每个人都应能获得教育机会。
none: Although several solutions were proposed, none addressed the underlying causes of inequality in access to education.
虽然提出了多种解决办法，但没有一种触及教育机会不平等的根本原因。
ocean: Plastic waste entering the ocean threatens marine wildlife and can eventually affect human health through food chains.
进入海洋的塑料垃圾威胁海洋野生动物，并最终可能通过食物链影响人类健康。
pleasant: Public gardens provide pleasant spaces where residents can exercise, socialise, and escape the pressures of urban life.
公共花园提供舒适宜人的空间，让居民锻炼、社交，并暂时摆脱城市生活的压力。
borrow: Many languages borrow words from others as international trade and cultural exchange bring communities closer.
随着国际贸易和文化交流拉近各群体的距离，许多语言会从其他语言中引入词汇。
seem: Although online courses seem convenient, some learners benefit more from direct interaction with teachers and classmates.
尽管网络课程似乎很方便，一些学习者仍能从与老师和同学的直接互动中获益更多。
shelf: Placing healthy snacks on shelves at eye level may encourage shoppers to make more nutritious food choices.
把健康零食摆在与视线齐平的货架上，可能促使购物者选择更有营养的食品。
portuguese: Learning Portuguese can help students access a wider range of literature and international career opportunities.
学习葡萄牙语能帮助学生接触更广泛的文学作品，并获得国际就业机会。
anyway: Some residents oppose the new railway, but the government intends to proceed anyway because of its economic benefits.
一些居民反对修建新铁路，但政府考虑到其经济效益，仍打算推进项目。
lipstick: Cosmetics companies are developing refillable lipstick containers to reduce packaging waste and respond to environmental concerns.
化妆品公司正在开发可替换内芯的口红管，以减少包装废弃物并回应环保关切。
cooker: Replacing an inefficient cooker with a modern appliance can reduce household energy consumption over time.
用现代设备替换低效炉灶，长远来看可以减少家庭能源消耗。
clothing: The clothing industry can reduce its environmental impact by using recycled materials and designing products that last longer.
服装行业可以通过使用再生材料和设计更耐穿的产品来减少对环境的影响。
height: Restricting the height of new buildings can protect historic views and preserve the character of older neighbourhoods.
限制新建筑的高度可以保护历史景观，并保留老街区的特色。
bake: Schools can teach children to bake simple foods as part of practical lessons about nutrition and independence.
学校可以教孩子烘焙简单的食物，将其作为营养与独立生活实践课的一部分。
gardener: Community gardeners can improve urban biodiversity by growing native plants that provide food and shelter for wildlife.
社区园艺爱好者可以种植为野生动物提供食物和栖息处的本土植物，从而改善城市生物多样性。
nearly: Nearly half of the surveyed residents supported expanding public transport rather than building additional roads.
受访居民中近一半支持扩建公共交通系统，而不是增建道路。
pyjamas: Choosing comfortable pyjamas and maintaining a regular bedtime may help children establish healthier sleep routines.
选择舒适的睡衣裤并保持固定的就寝时间，可能有助于儿童养成更健康的睡眠习惯。
century: Over the past century, improvements in sanitation have contributed significantly to longer life expectancy worldwide.
过去一个世纪里，卫生条件的改善对全球预期寿命的延长作出了重大贡献。
score: Test scores provide useful information, but they cannot fully reflect students' creativity or practical skills.
考试分数能提供有用的信息，却无法全面反映学生的创造力或实践技能。
cycling: Investing in safe cycling routes can encourage commuters to choose healthier and less polluting forms of transport.
投资建设安全的自行车道可以鼓励通勤者选择更健康、污染更少的交通方式。
act: Governments need to act decisively to reduce air pollution and protect the health of urban residents.
政府需要果断采取行动，减少空气污染，保护城市居民的健康。
season: A longer tourist season can create more stable employment, although it may increase pressure on local resources.
更长的旅游旺季可以创造更稳定的就业，但也可能加大当地资源的压力。
guess: Without reliable data, researchers can only guess how changes in transport costs will affect household spending.
没有可靠的数据，研究人员只能猜测交通费用变化会如何影响家庭支出。
timetable: A flexible school timetable can help students balance academic subjects with physical activity and creative learning.
灵活的学校课程表有助于学生兼顾文化课、体育活动和创造性学习。
princess: Traditional stories often portray a princess as dependent, whereas modern adaptations increasingly emphasise her independence and leadership.
传统故事常将公主塑造成依赖他人的形象，而现代改编作品越来越强调她的独立性和领导力。
gramme: Even a single gramme of certain pollutants can harm aquatic life when released into a small pond.
某些污染物即使只有一克，排入小池塘后也可能危害水生生物。
able: With reliable internet access, rural students are able to attend courses previously available only in cities.
有了可靠的互联网接入，农村学生就能参加以前只有城市才提供的课程。
ham: Processed meats such as ham often contain substantial amounts of salt, which consumers should consider when planning meals.
火腿等加工肉类通常含盐量较高，消费者安排膳食时应考虑这一点。
garbage: Cities can reduce the amount of garbage sent to landfill by improving recycling facilities and public awareness.
城市可以通过改善回收设施和提高公众意识，减少运往填埋场的垃圾量。
cleaner: Hospitals should provide every cleaner with suitable protective equipment and training to reduce infection risks.
医院应为每位清洁工提供合适的防护装备和培训，以降低感染风险。
pc: Providing each student with a PC may improve access to digital resources, but requires substantial funding.
为每个学生配备一台个人电脑或许能改善数字资源的获取条件，但需要大量资金。
degree: Although a university degree can improve employment prospects, practical experience remains highly valuable in many industries.
虽然大学学位能改善就业前景，但实践经验在许多行业仍然十分重要。
textbook: Digital textbooks can reduce school expenses, although some students find printed materials easier to study.
电子教材可以降低学校开支，不过一些学生觉得纸质材料更便于学习。
leather: Some consumers avoid leather products because they are concerned about animal welfare and the environmental impact of production.
一些消费者避免购买皮革制品，因为他们关心动物福利以及生产对环境的影响。
truck: Transporting goods by truck offers flexibility, but rail freight can reduce emissions over longer distances.
用卡车运输货物较为灵活，但长途铁路货运能减少排放。
toaster: Small appliances such as toasters should be designed for easy repair rather than frequent replacement.
烤面包机等小型电器的设计应便于维修，而不是让人频繁更换。
yogurt: Plain yogurt can contribute to a balanced diet by providing protein and calcium without added sugar.
原味酸奶能提供蛋白质和钙，且不含添加糖，有助于实现均衡饮食。
recent: Recent advances in medical technology have improved treatment options for patients living in remote communities.
医疗技术的近期进步改善了偏远社区患者的治疗选择。
burger: Restaurants can reduce their environmental impact by offering plant-based burgers alongside traditional meat dishes.
餐馆可以在供应传统肉类菜肴的同时提供植物基汉堡，以减少对环境的影响。
nearest: For many rural residents, the nearest hospital is several hours away, making access to emergency care difficult.

curtain: Installing a thick curtain over each window can reduce heat loss and improve comfort in older homes.
在每扇窗户上安装厚窗帘，可以减少热量流失，提升老房屋的居住舒适度。
pull: Horses once pulled heavy loads through cities, but motor vehicles eventually replaced them in most transport roles.

对考试感到紧张的学生可以从定期练习和教师的鼓励性反馈中获益。

学校应让学生有机会通过实验和实践项目，将科学知识付诸应用。

暑期旅游季开始前，志愿者仔细搜寻海滩上的塑料垃圾。

高尔夫球场可以吸引游客，但养护草坪可能需要大量用水。

住在嘈杂的道路附近可能影响城市居民的睡眠质量并加重压力。
bench: Installing benches along pedestrian routes can make city centres more accessible to older residents and people with limited mobility.
沿步行路线设置长凳，可以让老年居民和行动不便者更方便地使用市中心空间。
secret: Governments must balance the need to keep information secret with the public's right to know.
政府必须在信息保密的需要与公众的知情权之间取得平衡。
rise: A sharp rise in housing costs has forced many young adults to delay moving into their own homes.
住房成本大幅上涨，迫使许多年轻人推迟搬出去独立居住。
sir: In some schools, students address male teachers as sir to show respect during lessons.

already: Many cities have already introduced cycling schemes to reduce traffic congestion and improve public health.
许多城市已经推出骑行计划，以缓解交通拥堵并改善公众健康。
medicine: Advances in medicine have increased life expectancy, but access to effective treatment remains unequal across regions.

learning: Schools can encourage independent learning by giving students opportunities to investigate questions beyond the standard curriculum.
学校可以让学生探索常规课程之外的问题，以鼓励自主学习。
fishing: Strict limits on commercial fishing can help marine ecosystems recover and support coastal communities in the long term.

孩子们通过能够改善协调能力、培养团队精神的活动学习踢球和投球。

某些类型的公共交通更适合人口密集的城市，而非农村地区。
department: Each university department should review its courses regularly to ensure they reflect developments in the relevant field.
大学各系应定期审查课程，确保课程反映相关领域的发展。
necklace: A handmade necklace can reflect local traditions while providing income for craftspeople in rural communities.

corner: Shops on street corners can encourage walking by making everyday services more accessible to local residents.

ordinary: Urban planning should reflect the needs of ordinary residents rather than focus exclusively on attracting wealthy investors.
城市规划应反映普通居民的需求，而不是只顾吸引富有的投资者。

care: Affordable childcare enables more parents to remain employed while ensuring that young children receive appropriate care.

worry: Many parents worry that excessive screen time may affect their children's sleep and concentration.
许多家长担心，过长的屏幕使用时间可能影响孩子的睡眠和注意力。
fashion: The fashion industry can reduce its environmental impact by producing durable clothing and using recycled materials.
时装行业可以通过生产耐穿的衣服和使用回收材料来减少对环境的影响。
ship: Many countries ship agricultural products overseas, making reliable transport networks essential for economic growth.
许多国家向海外运送农产品，因此可靠的运输网络对经济增长至关重要。
slipper: Providing slippers in shared accommodation can improve comfort, although regular cleaning remains essential for good hygiene.
在合住场所提供拖鞋能提升舒适度，但保持良好卫生仍离不开定期清洁。
badly: Poorly maintained roads can badly affect rural communities by limiting access to schools, hospitals, and markets.

count: When evaluating educational success, students' confidence and creativity should count as much as examination results.
评估教育成效时，学生的自信和创造力应与考试成绩同样重要。
situation: The housing situation has become increasingly difficult for young people living in major cities.
对居住在大城市的年轻人来说，住房形势已变得日益严峻。
pilot: The council launched a pilot scheme to assess whether free bus travel would reduce traffic congestion.

continue: If housing costs continue to rise, more young adults may struggle to live independently in major cities.
如果住房成本持续上涨，更多年轻人可能难以在大城市独立生活。
watermelon: Growing watermelons in dry regions requires careful irrigation management to protect limited local water supplies.
在干旱地区种植西瓜需要谨慎管理灌溉，以保护当地有限的水资源。

经常运动能增强心脏功能，并降低患严重疾病的风险。

长期干旱天气会损害农作物，并威胁农业社区的粮食安全。

handwriting: Although digital devices are common in classrooms, clear handwriting remains useful for examinations and personal communication.
虽然数字设备在课堂上很常见，但清晰的手写字在考试和个人交流中仍然有用。
round: A further round of negotiations may help governments reach an agreement on reducing industrial emissions.

festival: An annual arts festival can attract visitors while providing local performers with valuable opportunities to reach wider audiences.

blond: In discussions of inherited traits, blond hair is often used as an example of human physical variation.
讨论遗传特征时，金发常被用作人类外貌差异的例子。
mark: Teachers should mark assignments consistently so that students receive fair and useful feedback.
教师批改作业时应采用一致的标准，让学生获得公平且有用的反馈。
huge: Investing in public transport could bring huge benefits to cities struggling with congestion and air pollution.

flu: Annual flu vaccinations can help protect vulnerable people and reduce pressure on hospitals during winter.
每年接种流感疫苗有助于保护易感人群，并减轻冬季医院的压力。
advertisement: Advertisements aimed at young consumers should present accurate information rather than encourage unnecessary spending.

hockey: Making hockey facilities more accessible could encourage greater participation in team sports among young people.

accident: Better street lighting can reduce the risk of accidents involving cyclists and pedestrians at night.

lake: Agricultural pollution can damage lake ecosystems and threaten the communities that rely on them for drinking water.

chance: Affordable training gives unemployed adults a chance to gain new skills and return to the workforce.

drawing: Drawing can help children express emotions that they may find difficult to communicate through spoken language.

dessert: Offering fresh fruit for dessert can help school cafeterias encourage healthier eating habits among children.

builder: Builders can reduce construction waste by choosing durable materials and planning resource use more carefully.
建筑商可以通过选择耐用材料和更细致地规划资源使用来减少建筑垃圾。
solve: Improving public transport could help solve traffic problems in rapidly growing urban areas.
改善公共交通有助于解决快速发展城区的交通问题。
spoon: Teaching children to use a spoon independently can help develop their coordination and confidence.
教孩子独立使用勺子有助于培养他们的协调能力和自信心。
disagree: Experts disagree on whether free public transport is the most effective way to reduce urban traffic.
专家对于免费公共交通是否是减少城市交通流量的最有效方法意见不一。
zipcode: Researchers grouped households by ZIP code to examine geographical differences in access to healthcare services.
研究人员按美国邮政编码对住户进行分组，以考察医疗服务可及性的地区差异。
author: An author can challenge social attitudes by presenting familiar problems through the experiences of unfamiliar characters.
作者可以借助陌生人物的经历呈现熟悉的问题，从而挑战社会观念。
soap: Providing clean water and soap in schools can help prevent infections and improve children's overall health.
在学校提供清洁用水和肥皂有助于预防感染，改善儿童的整体健康状况。
pea: Growing peas and other vegetables at school can help children understand where their food comes from.
在学校种植豌豆和其他蔬菜，可以帮助孩子了解食物的来源。
colourful: Colourful public murals can transform neglected urban spaces and encourage residents to take pride in their neighbourhoods.
色彩鲜艳的公共壁画能改变被忽视的城市空间，增强居民对社区的自豪感。
according-to: According to recent research, regular physical activity can improve concentration and reduce stress among university students.
根据近期研究，经常进行体育活动可以提高大学生的专注力并减轻压力。
throw: Schools can teach children to throw and catch safely through games that develop coordination and teamwork.
学校可以通过培养协调能力和团队精神的游戏，教孩子安全地投接球。
nasty: Nasty comments on social media can discourage young people from participating in otherwise valuable online discussions.
社交媒体上的恶意评论可能使年轻人不愿参与原本有价值的网络讨论。
explain: Differences in access to healthcare may partly explain why life expectancy varies considerably between regions.
医疗服务可及性的差异，可能在一定程度上解释不同地区预期寿命差距较大的原因。
possibly: Expanding urban green spaces could possibly reduce summer temperatures while improving residents' physical and mental health.
扩大城市绿地可能降低夏季气温，同时改善居民的身心健康。
silver: Silver is widely used in electronic devices because it conducts electricity exceptionally well.
银的导电性能极佳，因此被广泛用于电子设备。
copy: Students should learn to evaluate sources rather than simply copy information from websites into their assignments.
学生应学会评估资料来源，而不是直接把网站信息抄进作业。
travelling: Travelling abroad can broaden students' perspectives by exposing them to different customs and ways of life.
出国旅行能让学生接触不同的习俗和生活方式，从而拓宽视野。
differently: Students learn differently, so teachers should offer varied activities rather than rely on a single method.
学生的学习方式各不相同，因此教师应提供多样化活动，而不是依赖单一方法。
officer: A local housing officer can advise residents on applying for affordable accommodation and accessing financial support.
当地住房事务官员可以指导居民申请可负担住房并获取经济援助。
panda: Protecting panda habitats also benefits other species that depend on the same mountain forests for survival.
保护大熊猫栖息地也有益于其他依赖同一片山林生存的物种。
experience: Work experience can help graduates develop practical skills that employers value alongside academic qualifications.
工作经验能帮助毕业生培养实践技能，而雇主不仅重视学历，也看重这些技能。
increase: An increase in public transport investment could reduce traffic congestion and improve air quality in cities.
增加公共交通投资可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善城市空气质量。
belong: Community centres provide welcoming spaces where newcomers can feel they belong and build lasting friendships.
社区中心提供友好的空间，让新来者获得归属感并建立持久的友谊。
almost: Almost all participants agreed that affordable public transport would improve their access to employment opportunities.
几乎所有参与者都认为，价格实惠的公共交通能让他们获得更多就业机会。
tape-recorder: Before digital devices became widespread, researchers often used a tape-recorder to preserve interviews for later analysis.
在数字设备普及之前，研究人员常用磁带录音机保存访谈内容，以供后续分析。
exactly: Researchers must record exactly how much energy each household uses to ensure reliable comparisons between regions.
研究人员必须准确记录每户家庭的能耗，以确保地区之间的比较可靠。
either: Students can choose either vocational training or university education, depending on their interests and career goals.
学生可以根据自己的兴趣和职业目标，选择职业培训或大学教育。
camp: Schools can organise outdoor camps to help students develop independence and learn practical skills beyond the classroom.
学校可以组织户外营地活动，帮助学生培养独立性并学习课堂之外的实用技能。
suddenly: When demand suddenly increases, public transport systems may struggle to provide enough services for passengers.
当需求突然增加时，公共交通系统可能难以为乘客提供足够的班次。
gas: Reducing greenhouse gas emissions requires investment in cleaner energy and more efficient public transport systems.
减少温室气体排放需要投资更清洁的能源和更高效的公共交通系统。
scissors: Teachers should supervise young children when they use scissors during classroom craft activities.
幼儿在课堂手工活动中使用剪刀时，教师应在旁监督。
goldfish: Keeping goldfish in suitably sized tanks can teach children responsibility and the importance of animal welfare.
在大小适宜的鱼缸里养金鱼，可以教会孩子承担责任，并认识动物福利的重要性。
tail: Some animals use their tails for balance, which helps them move safely through complex forest habitats.
一些动物用尾巴保持平衡，这有助于它们在复杂的森林栖息地中安全移动。
own: People who own their homes may feel more financially secure, although maintenance costs can be substantial.
拥有住房的人可能在经济上更有安全感，不过房屋维护费用也可能相当高。
celebrate: Community festivals celebrate local traditions while giving residents opportunities to strengthen relationships with their neighbours.
社区节庆活动在弘扬当地传统的同时，也让居民有机会增进邻里关系。
wooden: Wooden buildings can offer environmental benefits when their materials come from responsibly managed forests.
如果木材来自负责任管理的森林，木制建筑就能带来环境效益。
necessary: Investment in public transport is necessary to reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.
投资公共交通对于缓解交通拥堵和改善城市空气质量是必要的。
suggest: Recent studies suggest that access to green spaces can improve mental health among urban residents.
近期研究表明，能够接触绿地可能有助于改善城市居民的心理健康。
air-conditioning: Greater reliance on air-conditioning during heatwaves can place considerable pressure on urban electricity supplies.
热浪期间对空调依赖加深，可能给城市电力供应带来很大压力。
messy: Without clear responsibilities, cooperation between public agencies can become messy and delay the delivery of essential services.
如果没有明确的职责，公共机构之间的合作可能变得混乱，延误基本服务的提供。
recently: Researchers have recently explored how access to green spaces influences the mental health of urban residents.
研究人员最近探讨了绿地的可及性如何影响城市居民的心理健康。
mostly: In many rural areas, residents rely mostly on private vehicles because public transport services are limited.
在许多农村地区，由于公共交通服务有限，居民主要依靠私家车出行。
musical: Schools that offer musical training give children valuable opportunities to develop creativity and practise teamwork.
提供音乐训练的学校为孩子们培养创造力和练习团队合作提供了宝贵机会。
shake: Repeated failures in public transport can shake commuters' confidence in the reliability of urban services.
公共交通反复出现故障，可能动摇通勤者对城市服务可靠性的信心。
litre: Measuring household water use in litres can help residents understand consumption and identify opportunities to reduce waste.
以升为单位测量家庭用水量，有助于居民了解消耗情况并找到减少浪费的方法。
haircut: Offering affordable haircuts at community centres can help trainee hairdressers gain practical experience while serving local residents.
在社区中心提供价格实惠的理发服务，能让实习理发师在服务当地居民的同时积累实践经验。
expect: Employers increasingly expect graduates to demonstrate practical skills as well as a strong understanding of their subject.
雇主越来越期望毕业生既展现实践技能，又具备扎实的专业知识。
pineapple: Growing pineapple for export can support rural incomes, but intensive farming may damage local soils.
种植菠萝用于出口可以增加农村收入，但集约化种植可能损害当地土壤。
bone: Regular weight-bearing exercise helps maintain bone strength and can reduce the risk of fractures in older adults.
规律的负重运动有助于保持骨骼强度，并能降低老年人骨折的风险。
mirror: Changes in consumer spending often mirror broader economic trends, particularly during periods of financial uncertainty.
消费者支出的变化往往反映更广泛的经济趋势，在金融形势不明朗时期尤其如此。
hut: Mountain huts provide essential shelter for hikers, but their construction should minimise damage to fragile ecosystems.
山间小屋为徒步者提供必要的庇护，但建造时应尽量减少对脆弱生态系统的破坏。
sour: Disagreements over shared resources can sour relations between neighbouring countries and delay important environmental projects.
共享资源方面的分歧可能使邻国关系恶化，并延误重要的环境项目。
currency: A weaker currency can attract international tourists by making accommodation and other services more affordable.
货币贬值可以降低住宿和其他服务的价格，从而吸引国际游客。
qualification: Employers increasingly value practical experience alongside formal qualifications when recruiting graduates for demanding professional roles.
招聘毕业生担任要求较高的专业岗位时，雇主越来越重视实际经验与正式学历。
issue: Governments must address the issue of housing affordability to ensure that young adults can live independently.
政府必须解决住房负担能力问题，确保年轻人能够独立生活。
indoors: Children who spend most of their time indoors may have fewer opportunities for physical activity.
大部分时间待在室内的孩子可能较少有机会进行体育活动。
amaze: Advances in medical technology continue to amaze researchers and offer new hope to patients with complex conditions.
医疗技术的进步不断令研究人员惊叹，也为病情复杂的患者带来新的希望。
maker: Car makers are investing in cleaner technologies to meet stricter environmental standards and changing consumer expectations.
汽车制造商正在投资更清洁的技术，以满足更严格的环保标准和不断变化的消费者期望。
solution: Investment in renewable energy offers a long-term solution to the environmental problems caused by fossil fuels.
投资可再生能源为化石燃料造成的环境问题提供了长期解决方案。
therefore: Public parks encourage physical activity and social interaction; therefore, cities should invest in maintaining accessible green spaces.
公共公园有助于促进体育活动和社交互动，因此城市应投入资金维护方便使用的绿地。
routine: Maintaining a regular sleep routine can improve concentration and help students cope with academic pressure.
保持规律的睡眠作息能提高注意力，帮助学生应对学业压力。
claim: Some researchers claim that access to green spaces can improve mental health and strengthen community relationships.
一些研究人员认为，能够使用绿地有助于改善心理健康并加强社区联系。
confidence: Supportive feedback can build students' confidence and encourage them to participate more actively in classroom discussions.
鼓励性的反馈可以增强学生的自信，促使他们更积极地参与课堂讨论。
volunteer: Universities can encourage students to volunteer in their communities by offering flexible schedules and practical support.
大学可以通过提供灵活的时间安排和实际支持，鼓励学生参与社区志愿服务。
switch: Governments can encourage households to switch to renewable energy by offering financial support.
政府可以提供经济支持，鼓励家庭改用可再生能源。
block: Poorly parked vehicles can block access to public buildings, creating difficulties for wheelchair users.
停放不当的车辆可能堵住公共建筑的入口，给轮椅使用者带来困难。
mild: Even mild air pollution can affect vulnerable groups, making regular monitoring essential in densely populated cities.
即使轻度空气污染也会影响易受伤害的群体，因此人口密集的城市必须定期监测空气质量。
hostel: Youth hostels make international travel more affordable for students while encouraging interaction between people from different backgrounds.
青年旅舍让学生更能负担国际旅行，同时促进不同背景的人之间的交流。
inch: During rush hour, buses inch through crowded streets, making public transport less attractive to commuters.
高峰时段，公交车在拥挤的街道上缓慢行驶，降低了公共交通对通勤者的吸引力。
sister-in-law: Sharing childcare with a sister-in-law can help working parents balance professional responsibilities and family life.
与姑嫂分担育儿工作，可以帮助在职父母平衡工作责任与家庭生活。
rope: Climbers should inspect their ropes regularly because damaged equipment can put the entire group at risk.
登山者应定期检查绳索，因为损坏的装备可能危及整个团队。
pour: When factories pour untreated waste into rivers, they threaten aquatic ecosystems and nearby communities' drinking water.
工厂将未经处理的废弃物排入河流时，会威胁水生生态系统及附近社区的饮用水安全。
awesome: The awesome power of volcanic eruptions highlights the importance of effective monitoring systems in nearby communities.
火山喷发令人敬畏的威力凸显了周边社区建立有效监测系统的重要性。
comic: Comic characters can make educational programmes more engaging and help children remember important information.
滑稽的角色可以让教育节目更有吸引力，帮助儿童记住重要信息。
content: Schools should teach students to evaluate online content critically rather than accepting every claim as reliable information.
学校应教学生批判性地评估网络内容，而不是把每一种说法都当作可靠信息。
dozen: Dozens of community gardens have opened across the city, giving residents more opportunities to grow food.
全市已开设数十个社区菜园，让居民有更多机会种植食物。
development: Investment in public transport can support economic development while reducing traffic congestion in growing cities.
投资公共交通既能支持经济发展，也能缓解扩张中的城市的交通拥堵。
currently: Many cities are currently investing in cycling infrastructure to reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.
许多城市目前正在投资建设自行车基础设施，以缓解交通拥堵并改善城市空气质量。
freezing: Freezing temperatures can damage water pipes and disrupt essential services, particularly in areas with ageing infrastructure.
冰冻天气可能损坏水管并扰乱基本服务，尤其是在基础设施老化的地区。
fitness: Schools can improve children's fitness by providing regular opportunities for enjoyable physical activity throughout the week.
学校可以在一周内定期提供有趣的体育活动机会，以增强儿童体能。
summary: A clear summary at the beginning of a report helps readers understand its main findings quickly.
报告开头清晰的概要有助于读者迅速了解主要研究结果。
statue: Public statues can preserve local history, but communities should discuss which figures deserve such recognition.
公共雕像可以保存地方历史，但社区应讨论哪些人物值得获得这样的认可。
political: Political stability can encourage long-term investment and help governments maintain essential public services.
政治稳定能够鼓励长期投资，并帮助政府维持必要的公共服务。
cabbage: Locally grown vegetables such as cabbage can support healthier diets while reducing the environmental impact of food transport.
卷心菜等本地种植的蔬菜有助于改善饮食健康，同时减少食品运输对环境的影响。
inexpensive: Cycling offers an inexpensive alternative to driving and can help reduce traffic congestion in growing cities.
骑自行车是驾车之外一种经济实惠的选择，也有助于缓解发展中城市的交通拥堵。
rug: Placing a rug on a hard floor can reduce noise and make shared housing more comfortable.
在硬地板上铺一块小地毯可以降低噪声，让合住空间更舒适。
agent: Local community groups can act as agents of change by encouraging residents to adopt more sustainable habits.
当地社区团体可以鼓励居民养成更可持续的生活习惯，从而推动变革。
port: Expanding the port could increase international trade, but it may also damage nearby marine habitats.
扩建港口可能促进国际贸易，但也可能破坏附近的海洋生境。
workplace: Creating an inclusive workplace helps employees feel valued and encourages cooperation among people from different backgrounds.
营造包容的工作环境有助于员工感到受重视，并促进不同背景的人之间的合作。
intelligent: Intelligent transport systems can reduce congestion by adjusting traffic signals in response to changing road conditions.
智能交通系统可以根据道路状况的变化调整交通信号，从而缓解拥堵。
employment: Investment in renewable energy can create employment opportunities while helping countries meet their climate targets.
投资可再生能源可以创造就业机会，同时帮助各国实现气候目标。
equator: Regions near the equator receive intense sunlight throughout the year, contributing to consistently high temperatures.
赤道附近的地区全年受到强烈的阳光照射，因此气温持续偏高。
suncream: Schools can encourage children to use suncream and seek shade during outdoor activities in sunny weather.
学校可以鼓励孩子们在晴天参加户外活动时涂防晒霜并注意遮阴。
signed: A signed agreement helps protect both tenants and landlords by clearly defining their rights and responsibilities.
签署的协议通过明确租客和房东的权利与责任，有助于保护双方。
waterproof: Outdoor workers need waterproof clothing to remain comfortable and protected when carrying out tasks in wet weather.
户外工作者需要防水衣物，以便在潮湿天气作业时保持舒适并得到保护。
disabled: Universities should provide accessible facilities and appropriate support to ensure that disabled students can participate fully in campus life.
大学应提供无障碍设施和适当支持，确保残障学生能够充分参与校园生活。
supply: Cities must secure a reliable water supply as population growth and climate change place increasing pressure on resources.
随着人口增长和气候变化给资源带来越来越大的压力，城市必须确保可靠的供水。
full-time: Affordable childcare enables more parents to return to full-time employment without placing excessive pressure on family finances.
负担得起的托育服务使更多家长能够重返全职工作，同时不会给家庭经济带来过大压力。
multiply: Bacteria can multiply rapidly in warm conditions, making proper food storage essential for public health.
细菌在温暖环境中能迅速繁殖，因此妥善储存食物对公共健康至关重要。
request: Residents can request detailed information about proposed developments before local authorities make their final planning decisions.
在地方政府作出最终规划决定之前，居民可以要求获取拟建项目的详细信息。
recycle: Cities can reduce landfill waste by making it easier for residents to recycle everyday packaging.
城市可以通过方便居民回收日常包装来减少填埋垃圾。
conference: At the international conference, researchers discussed how cities could reduce air pollution without limiting economic growth.
在国际会议上，研究人员讨论了城市如何在不限制经济增长的情况下减少空气污染。
roast: Families can roast seasonal vegetables at home to prepare nutritious meals without relying on highly processed foods.
家庭可以在家烤时令蔬菜，做出营养丰富的饭菜，而不必依赖高度加工的食品。
hero: Films often portray the hero as an exceptional individual, although real social progress usually requires collective effort.
电影常把主人公塑造成非凡的个人，然而真正的社会进步通常需要集体努力。
chop: When communities chop down trees for fuel, they may unintentionally damage habitats and increase soil erosion.
当社区居民砍树用作燃料时，他们可能无意中破坏栖息地，加剧水土流失。
olive: Olive cultivation supports rural livelihoods in dry regions, although prolonged drought can significantly reduce harvests.
橄榄种植支撑着干旱地区农村居民的生计，但长期干旱会使收成大幅下降。
sadness: Regular social contact can help reduce feelings of sadness among older people who live alone.
经常与人交往有助于减轻独居老年人的悲伤情绪。
cab: Affordable night buses could reduce reliance on cabs among workers whose shifts end after midnight.
价格实惠的夜间公交车可以减少午夜后下班的工人对出租车的依赖。
chapter: The final chapter examines how public transport investment can reduce inequality in rapidly growing cities.
最后一章探讨公共交通投资如何减少快速发展城市中的不平等现象。
update: Governments should regularly update environmental regulations to reflect scientific discoveries and respond to emerging risks.
政府应定期更新环境法规，以反映科学发现并应对新出现的风险。
concentrate: Governments should concentrate resources on preventive healthcare to reduce pressure on hospitals in the long term.
政府应将资源集中于预防性医疗，以长期减轻医院的压力。
gorgeous: Although coastal destinations offer gorgeous scenery, uncontrolled tourism can damage the natural environments that attract visitors.
虽然海滨旅游地景色迷人，但不加控制的旅游活动会破坏吸引游客的自然环境。
glance: Commuters often glance at their phones while walking, which can reduce their awareness of nearby traffic.
通勤者常在走路时瞥看手机，这可能降低他们对周围交通状况的警觉性。
embarrass: Correcting every mistake publicly can embarrass language learners and discourage them from participating in classroom discussions.
公开纠正每一个错误会让语言学习者感到尴尬，并使他们不愿参与课堂讨论。
tube: Taking the tube instead of driving can help commuters avoid congestion in central London.
乘地铁而不是开车可以帮助通勤者避开伦敦市中心的交通拥堵。
vehicle: Electric vehicles can reduce urban air pollution, especially when their electricity comes from renewable sources.
电动车可以减少城市空气污染，尤其是在使用可再生能源发电时。
environmental: Governments should consider the environmental impact of new roads before approving major construction projects.
政府在批准大型建设项目之前，应考虑新道路对环境的影响。
starfish: Changes in ocean temperature can affect starfish populations and disrupt the balance of coastal ecosystems.
海水温度变化会影响海星种群，并扰乱沿海生态系统的平衡。
incredible: Advances in medical technology have brought incredible improvements in the quality of life for many patients.
医疗技术的进步使许多患者的生活质量得到了惊人的改善。
ladder: Access to professional training can help young employees move up the career ladder more quickly.
获得专业培训的机会可以帮助年轻员工更快地晋升。
responsibility: Governments and businesses share responsibility for reducing waste, but individuals also have an important role to play.
政府和企业共同承担减少废物的责任，但个人也发挥着重要作用。
electrician: Training more qualified electricians is essential as households increasingly adopt solar panels and electric vehicle charging equipment.
随着越来越多家庭安装太阳能板和电动汽车充电设备，培养更多合格电工至关重要。
destination: Popular tourist destinations must balance economic benefits with the need to protect local communities and natural environments.
热门旅游目的地必须在经济收益与保护当地社区和自然环境的需要之间取得平衡。
shiny: Shiny packaging may attract consumers, but it often creates waste that is difficult to recycle.
亮丽的包装可能吸引消费者，但往往会产生难以回收的废弃物。
giant: Technology giants have considerable influence over how people access information and communicate with one another.
科技巨头对人们获取信息和相互交流的方式有很大影响。
unit: Each unit of the course introduces practical skills that students can apply in the workplace.
这门课程的每个单元都介绍学生可以在工作中运用的实用技能。
scream: Residents complain that visitors scream late at night, disturbing sleep and reducing the neighbourhood's quality of life.
居民抱怨游客深夜尖叫，扰人睡眠，降低了社区的生活质量。
powerful: Powerful companies should take greater responsibility for reducing the environmental damage caused by their operations.
有影响力的企业应承担更大责任，减少其经营活动造成的环境破坏。
poetry: Studying poetry encourages students to explore complex emotions and appreciate the expressive possibilities of language.
学习诗歌能鼓励学生探索复杂情感，并欣赏语言丰富的表达潜力。
foolish: It would be foolish to expand road networks without considering their long-term effects on air quality.
不考虑道路扩张对空气质量的长期影响就扩大路网，是不明智的。
measure: Governments should introduce effective measures to reduce air pollution without placing excessive costs on low-income households.
政府应采取有效措施减少空气污染，同时避免让低收入家庭承担过高费用。
hanger: Retailers can reduce plastic waste by collecting used hangers and replacing damaged ones with recyclable alternatives.
零售商可以回收旧衣架，并用可回收的替代品更换损坏的衣架，从而减少塑料垃圾。
jewel: The restored theatre is a cultural jewel that attracts visitors and supports local businesses.
修复后的剧院是一颗文化明珠，吸引着游客，也带动了当地商业。
image: Companies increasingly use social media to improve their public image and build stronger relationships with customers.
企业越来越多地利用社交媒体改善公众形象，并加强与客户的联系。
monster: Stories about monsters can help children explore their fears within a safe and imaginative setting.
有关怪物的故事可以帮助儿童在安全且富有想象力的情境中探索自己的恐惧。
target: Governments should set realistic targets for reducing emissions and regularly assess progress towards achieving them.
政府应制定切实可行的减排目标，并定期评估实现目标的进展。
fluent: Fluent speakers may still make grammatical mistakes, so language assessments should consider both communication skills and accuracy.
说话流利的人仍可能犯语法错误，因此语言测评应同时考虑沟通能力和准确性。
rub: Protective gloves prevent workers from rubbing their skin against rough surfaces when handling heavy materials.
搬运重物时，防护手套可以避免工人的皮肤与粗糙表面摩擦。
lighthouse: Although modern navigation relies on satellites, lighthouses remain valuable landmarks along dangerous stretches of coastline.
尽管现代导航依赖卫星，灯塔在危险海岸地段仍是重要的地标。
response: A rapid response to disease outbreaks can protect vulnerable communities and reduce pressure on local hospitals.
迅速应对疾病暴发能够保护脆弱群体，并减轻当地医院的压力。
solar: Investment in solar energy can reduce dependence on fossil fuels and create jobs in rural communities.
投资太阳能可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，并为农村社区创造就业机会。
access: Affordable internet access enables rural students to benefit from a wider range of educational resources.
价格可负担的互联网接入能让农村学生受益于更丰富的教育资源。
unlike: Unlike private cars, public transport can move large groups of people while using relatively little road space.
与私家车不同，公共交通能在占用较少道路空间的同时运送大量乘客。
argument: The strongest argument for public transport investment is its potential to reduce urban air pollution.
支持投资公共交通最有力的论据是，它有望减少城市空气污染。
ashamed: Students should never feel ashamed to ask for help when they struggle with difficult subjects.
学生在学习较难的科目遇到困难时，绝不应因求助而感到难堪。
income: Affordable public transport allows families on low incomes to access employment and essential services more easily.
价格实惠的公共交通让低收入家庭更容易获得就业机会和基本服务。
outdoors: Spending time outdoors can improve children's wellbeing and encourage greater interest in protecting the natural environment.
在户外活动能改善儿童的身心健康，并增强他们保护自然环境的兴趣。
favour: Many residents favour investment in public transport because it can reduce congestion and improve air quality.
许多居民支持投资公共交通，因为这有助于缓解拥堵并改善空气质量。
nightmare: Without reliable public transport, commuting can become a nightmare for people living outside major cities.
如果没有可靠的公共交通，通勤对住在大城市外围的人来说可能十分煎熬。
underwear: Consumers increasingly prefer underwear made from breathable fabrics, encouraging manufacturers to improve comfort and durability.
消费者越来越偏爱透气面料制成的内衣，这促使制造商提升舒适度和耐用性。
queue: Improved ticketing systems can reduce the time passengers spend waiting in a queue at busy stations.
改进售票系统可以减少乘客在繁忙车站排队等候的时间。
berry: Protecting native shrubs ensures that birds have access to berries and other food sources throughout the year.
保护本地灌木可以确保鸟类全年都能获取浆果及其他食物。
lighter: A refillable lighter may produce less plastic waste than disposable alternatives when used over a long period.
长期使用时，可补充燃料的打火机可能比一次性产品产生更少的塑料垃圾。
branch: Opening a local branch allows banks to provide essential services to communities with limited internet access.
开设当地分行能让银行为互联网接入有限的社区提供必要服务。
nest: Protecting trees where rare birds nest is essential for maintaining biodiversity in areas affected by urban development.
在受城市开发影响的地区，保护珍稀鸟类筑巢的树木对维持生物多样性至关重要。
decrease: Improved public transport could decrease traffic congestion and reduce air pollution in densely populated cities.
改善公共交通可以缓解人口密集城市的交通拥堵，并减少空气污染。
comment: Residents should have opportunities to comment on development proposals before local authorities make final decisions.
地方政府作出最终决定前，居民应有机会对开发提案发表意见。
soil: Intensive farming can damage soil quality, reducing the land's ability to support crops over time.
集约化农业可能损害土壤质量，逐渐降低土地种植作物的能力。
risk: Governments should assess the risk of flooding before approving new housing developments near rivers.
政府在批准河流附近的新住宅开发项目之前，应评估洪水风险。
handsome: Companies investing in renewable energy may earn handsome profits as demand for cleaner alternatives continues to grow.
随着对更清洁替代能源的需求持续增长，投资可再生能源的企业可能获得丰厚利润。
schedule: Universities should schedule examinations carefully to give students sufficient time for revision and recovery between assessments.
大学应合理安排考试，让学生在各项考核之间有足够的复习和休息时间。
error: Researchers should check their calculations carefully, as a minor error can significantly affect the final conclusions.
研究人员应仔细核查计算过程，因为一个小错误就可能显著影响最终结论。
tyre: Recycling used tyres can reduce landfill waste and provide materials for safer playground surfaces.
回收旧轮胎可以减少填埋垃圾，并为更安全的游乐场地面提供材料。
skyscraper: Building skyscrapers can accommodate growing urban populations, but cities must also invest in reliable public transport.
建造摩天大楼可以容纳不断增长的城市人口，但城市也必须投资建设可靠的公共交通。
tiredness: Persistent tiredness can reduce students' concentration and may indicate that they are not getting enough sleep.
持续的疲劳会降低学生的专注力，也可能表明他们睡眠不足。
terribly: Without reliable public transport, elderly residents may feel terribly isolated in remote rural communities.
如果没有可靠的公共交通，偏远农村社区的老年居民可能会感到非常孤立。
follower: Having many followers on social media does not necessarily make someone a reliable source of health advice.
在社交媒体上拥有众多关注者，并不一定意味着一个人能提供可靠的健康建议。
prayer: For many communities, prayer provides comfort during difficult times and strengthens a sense of belonging.
对许多群体而言，祈祷能在艰难时期带来慰藉，并增强归属感。
mend: Teaching children to mend their clothes can reduce textile waste and encourage more responsible attitudes towards consumption.
教孩子修补衣物可以减少纺织废料，并培养更负责任的消费态度。
antarctica: Scientists studying Antarctica analyse ancient ice to understand how the Earth's climate has changed over time.
研究南极洲的科学家通过分析古老冰层，了解地球气候如何随时间变化。
attraction: Although tourism creates jobs, overcrowding at major attractions can damage historic buildings and disrupt local life.
虽然旅游业创造就业机会，但主要景点过度拥挤可能损坏历史建筑，扰乱当地生活。
bull: During a bull market, rising share prices may encourage households to invest more of their savings.
在牛市期间，股价上涨可能促使家庭将更多储蓄用于投资。
bury: Instead of burying household waste, local authorities should invest in recycling facilities and public education.
地方政府不应只是填埋生活垃圾，而应投资建设回收设施并开展公众教育。
register: Residents should be able to register for local healthcare services online, reducing unnecessary travel and administrative delays.
居民应能在线登记使用当地医疗服务，以减少不必要的出行和行政延误。
attach: Many employers attach greater importance to practical experience than to academic qualifications when recruiting new staff.
许多雇主招聘新员工时，更看重实际经验而非学历。
respect: Schools should encourage students to respect different opinions while evaluating the evidence behind each argument.
学校应鼓励学生尊重不同观点，同时评估每种论点背后的证据。
base: Governments should base their environmental policies on reliable scientific evidence rather than short-term political interests.
政府应以可靠的科学证据而非短期政治利益为依据制定环境政策。
depart: Buses that depart regularly from residential areas can reduce commuters' dependence on private cars.
从住宅区定时发车的公交车可以减少通勤者对私家车的依赖。
subtraction: A secure understanding of subtraction helps children develop the numerical skills needed for everyday financial decisions.
扎实理解减法有助于儿童培养日常财务决策所需的计算能力。
understanding: Learning another language can deepen students' understanding of different cultures and encourage greater respect for others.
学习另一种语言可以加深学生对不同文化的理解，并促进对他人的尊重。
receipt: Businesses should issue a receipt for every purchase to protect consumers and maintain accurate financial records.
商家应为每笔购买开具收据，以保护消费者并保留准确的财务记录。
option: Remote working gives employees the option to live further from expensive city centres without changing jobs.
远程办公让员工可以选择住在远离高房价市中心的地方，而不必换工作。
pavement: Wider pavements can improve pedestrian safety and make urban neighbourhoods more accessible for wheelchair users.
更宽的人行道可以提高行人安全性，并让轮椅使用者更方便地在城市社区出行。
dial: People who struggle with touchscreens may find a physical dial easier to use when adjusting household appliances.
不擅长使用触摸屏的人在调节家用电器时，可能觉得实体旋钮更方便。
marvelous: Public libraries offer a marvelous opportunity for people of all ages to explore new interests.
公共图书馆为各年龄段的人探索新兴趣提供了极好的机会。
requirement: Clear entry requirements help prospective students assess whether they are adequately prepared for university courses.
明确的入学要求有助于有意申请的学生判断自己是否已为大学课程做好充分准备。
continent: Climate change affects every continent, although its consequences vary considerably between regions and communities.
气候变化影响每一个洲，但其后果因地区和群体而有很大差异。
afford: Without financial assistance, many students cannot afford to attend university despite having strong academic potential.
如果没有经济援助，许多学生即使有很强的学术潜力，也无力负担大学费用。
object: Many residents object to the proposed airport expansion because it could increase noise pollution.
许多居民反对拟议中的机场扩建，因为这可能加剧噪声污染。
dizzy: People who feel dizzy during exercise should stop immediately and seek medical advice if symptoms persist.
运动时感到头晕的人应立即停下；若症状持续，应咨询医生。
cheating: Schools can discourage cheating by designing assessments that reward independent thinking rather than the simple recall of facts.
学校可以设计重视独立思考而非单纯记忆事实的考核，以减少作弊。
stress: Schools should teach students practical strategies for managing stress during examinations and other demanding periods.
学校应教给学生实用的方法，帮助他们应对考试及其他紧张时期的压力。
absent: Students who are frequently absent from school may require additional support to keep up with their classmates.
经常缺课的学生可能需要额外帮助，才能跟上同学的学习进度。
poet: A poet can challenge social attitudes by expressing familiar experiences in unexpected and emotionally powerful ways.
诗人可以用出人意料且富有感染力的方式表达日常体验，从而挑战社会观念。
essential: Access to clean drinking water is essential for preventing disease and improving public health.
获得清洁饮用水对预防疾病和改善公共卫生至关重要。
whale: Protecting whale populations requires international cooperation because these marine mammals migrate across vast areas of ocean.
保护鲸类种群需要国际合作，因为这些海洋哺乳动物会跨越广阔海域迁徙。
economics: Studying economics helps students understand how government policies influence employment, inflation, and the distribution of wealth.
学习经济学有助于学生理解政府政策如何影响就业、通货膨胀和财富分配。
pond: Creating ponds in urban parks can provide valuable habitats for amphibians and increase local biodiversity.
在城市公园中建造池塘可以为两栖动物提供宝贵的栖息地，并增加当地的生物多样性。
delighted: Residents were delighted with the new library, which offered free internet access and a welcoming space for study.
居民对新图书馆感到十分满意，那里提供免费上网服务和舒适宜人的学习空间。
microphone: Using a microphone during lectures can help students hear clearly, particularly in large classrooms with poor acoustics.
讲课时使用麦克风可以帮助学生听清内容，尤其是在声学条件较差的大教室里。
drum: Learning to play the drum can help children develop coordination and participate in group performances.
学习打鼓能帮助儿童培养协调能力，并参与集体表演。
magician: A skilled magician can demonstrate how easily human attention is directed away from important visual details.
技艺娴熟的魔术师可以展示，人的注意力多么容易被引开，从而忽略重要的视觉细节。
professional: Continuous professional development helps teachers adapt their methods to changing student needs and new educational technologies.
持续的专业发展帮助教师调整教学方法，以适应学生需求的变化和新的教育技术。
stir: Documentaries about endangered animals can stir public concern and encourage stronger support for wildlife conservation.
关于濒危动物的纪录片能够唤起公众的关注，促使人们更加支持野生动物保护。
major: Access to affordable childcare remains a major concern for parents who wish to return to work.
对于希望重返职场的父母而言，能否获得负担得起的托育服务仍是一个主要顾虑。
arithmetic: Strong arithmetic skills help young adults manage personal budgets and make informed financial decisions.
扎实的算术能力有助于年轻人管理个人预算，并作出明智的财务决策。
shoot: Film crews often shoot documentaries in remote locations to highlight the effects of climate change.
摄制组常在偏远地区拍摄纪录片，以突出气候变化的影响。
pigeon: Urban pigeon populations often grow where food waste is abundant, highlighting the importance of effective rubbish collection.
城市里食物垃圾丰富的地方，鸽子数量往往会增加，这凸显了有效清运垃圾的重要性。
industry: Investment in cleaner technology could help heavy industry reduce emissions without significantly lowering production levels.
投资更清洁的技术可帮助重工业减少排放，同时不显著降低生产水平。
opportunity: Public libraries provide an important opportunity for residents to develop skills without paying expensive course fees.
公共图书馆为居民提供了培养技能的重要机会，无须支付昂贵的课程费用。
cutlery: Restaurants can reduce plastic waste by replacing disposable cutlery with durable alternatives that can be washed and reused.
餐馆可以用可清洗、可重复使用的耐用餐具替代一次性餐具，以减少塑料垃圾。
nor: Expanding roads alone will neither solve traffic congestion nor reduce the environmental damage caused by private vehicles.
仅仅拓宽道路既不能解决交通拥堵，也无法减少私家车造成的环境破坏。
contact: Regular contact with family members can reduce loneliness among older people who live alone.
经常与家人联系可以减轻独居老年人的孤独感。
woollen: Although woollen clothing provides excellent insulation, its environmental impact depends partly on farming practices and manufacturing methods.
虽然羊毛衣物保暖性能优良，但其环境影响部分取决于养殖方式和制造方法。
prevent: Investing in early health education can help prevent chronic diseases and reduce future pressure on public healthcare services.
投资早期健康教育有助于预防慢性病，并减轻公共医疗服务未来的压力。
mad: Although some residents are mad about football, public sports funding should support a wider range of activities.
虽然一些居民热衷足球，但公共体育资金应支持更广泛的活动。
jail: Education programmes in jail can help prisoners develop skills and improve their chances of finding work after release.
监狱中的教育项目能帮助服刑人员培养技能，提高他们获释后找到工作的机会。
disadvantage: Students without reliable internet access face a significant disadvantage when schools rely heavily on online learning.
当学校高度依赖线上学习时，无法稳定上网的学生会明显处于不利地位。
familiar: Students who are familiar with digital tools may adapt more easily to online learning environments.
熟悉数字工具的学生可能更容易适应在线学习环境。
marvellous: Public gardens offer marvellous opportunities for urban residents to relax and reconnect with nature.
公共花园为城市居民提供了放松身心、重新亲近自然的绝佳机会。
cough: People with a persistent cough should seek medical advice, particularly if symptoms interfere with sleep or daily activities.
持续咳嗽的人应就医咨询，尤其是在症状影响睡眠或日常活动时。
racket: Providing basic equipment, such as a racket, can make school sports more accessible to children.
提供球拍等基本器材，可以让更多孩子参与学校体育活动。
similarly: Public libraries provide free access to information; similarly, community centres offer valuable opportunities for lifelong learning.
公共图书馆提供免费获取信息的渠道；同样，社区中心也为终身学习提供宝贵机会。
jug: Serving tap water in a reusable jug can help restaurants reduce their reliance on disposable plastic bottles.
用可重复使用的水壶供应自来水，有助于餐馆减少对一次性塑料瓶的依赖。
fashionable: Consumers often replace fashionable clothing quickly, increasing textile waste and placing pressure on natural resources.
消费者往往很快就更换时髦的服装，增加了纺织废料，也给自然资源带来压力。
cracker: Although crackers are convenient snacks, some varieties contain substantial amounts of salt and should be eaten in moderation.
虽然薄脆饼干食用方便，但某些种类含盐量较高，应适量食用。
my: In my view, cities should prioritise affordable housing rather than invest heavily in prestigious construction projects.
在我看来，城市应优先提供可负担住房，而非大量投资于彰显声望的建设项目。
later: Children who develop strong reading habits often achieve better academic results later in life.
养成良好阅读习惯的孩子，往往在日后的学习中取得更好的成绩。
soon: Unless cities improve public transport soon, traffic congestion is likely to become increasingly severe.
除非城市尽快改善公共交通，否则交通拥堵很可能日益严重。
umbrella: An umbrella organisation can help small charities coordinate their activities and share resources more effectively.
一个联合组织可以帮助小型慈善机构协调活动，更有效地共享资源。
after: After cities improve public transport, more residents may choose to leave their cars at home.
城市改善公共交通后，更多居民可能会选择不开车出门。
around: Planting trees around school buildings can provide shade and reduce indoor temperatures during hot weather.
在教学楼周围种树可以提供遮阴，并在炎热天气下降低室内温度。
by: Urban air quality can be improved by expanding public transport and encouraging residents to cycle more often.
扩大公共交通服务并鼓励居民更多骑车，可以改善城市空气质量。
smell: A reduced sense of smell can affect appetite and make it harder to detect spoiled food.
嗅觉减退会影响食欲，也会让人更难察觉变质的食物。
grandparent: A grandparent can provide valuable emotional support when both parents work outside the home.
当父母都在外工作时，祖父母或外祖父母可以提供宝贵的情感支持。
friendly: Friendly staff can improve patients' experiences and encourage them to seek medical advice earlier.
亲切的工作人员能改善患者的就医体验，并鼓励他们更早寻求医疗建议。
wide: Universities should offer a wide range of courses to meet students' different interests and career goals.
大学应提供种类丰富的课程，以满足学生不同的兴趣和职业目标。
fly: Choosing to travel by train rather than fly can significantly reduce the environmental impact of short journeys.
短途出行选择火车而非飞机，可以显著减少对环境的影响。
cold: Cold weather can increase household energy costs, placing additional pressure on families with limited incomes.
寒冷天气会增加家庭能源开支，给收入有限的家庭带来额外压力。
children: Safe public parks give children opportunities to exercise, develop social skills, and explore the natural world.

trousers: Some employers require staff to wear formal trousers, while others allow more casual clothing in the workplace.

variety: Schools should offer a wide variety of activities to support students with different interests.
学校应提供丰富多样的活动，以支持兴趣各异的学生。
chew: Children should be encouraged to chew food thoroughly and develop healthy eating habits from an early age.
应鼓励儿童充分咀嚼食物，从小养成健康的饮食习惯。
hopefully: Hopefully, improvements in cycling infrastructure will encourage more residents to leave their cars at home.
希望自行车基础设施的改善能鼓励更多居民放弃开车出行。
christian: Christian charities, alongside other religious and secular organisations, provide essential support for vulnerable communities in many countries.
在许多国家，基督教慈善机构与其他宗教及世俗组织一起，为弱势群体提供重要支持。
purpose: The main purpose of public libraries is to provide equal access to information and learning opportunities.
公共图书馆的主要目的是让人们平等地获取信息和学习机会。
pollution: Reducing pollution requires governments to regulate industrial emissions while encouraging cleaner transport and more sustainable production methods.
减少污染需要政府监管工业排放，同时鼓励更清洁的交通方式和更可持续的生产方式。
central: Access to reliable information is central to helping citizens make informed decisions about public health.

公共建筑应提供无台阶入口和宽敞的电梯，让轮椅使用者能够独立通行。
junction: Installing better lighting at busy junctions could reduce accidents involving cyclists and pedestrians.
在繁忙路口安装更好的照明设施，可以减少涉及骑行者和行人的事故。
campaign: Public health campaigns can encourage healthier habits, especially when supported by affordable access to nutritious food.
公共卫生宣传活动能促进更健康的习惯，尤其是在居民能够负担并获得营养食物的情况下。
bitter: Proposals to close local libraries have sparked bitter disputes between residents and local authorities.
关闭当地图书馆的提议引发了居民与地方政府之间的激烈争议。
overnight: Investment in public transport can improve urban mobility, but meaningful changes rarely happen overnight.
投资公共交通可以改善城市出行，但实质性变化很少能一夜实现。
universe: Research into the origins of the universe has driven advances in telescope technology and data analysis.
对宇宙起源的研究推动了望远镜技术和数据分析的进步。
background: Universities should provide equal opportunities for applicants from different social backgrounds, regardless of their family income.
大学应为来自不同社会背景的申请者提供平等机会，不论其家庭收入如何。
direct: Improved public transport can have a direct impact on employment by connecting residents with more job opportunities.
改善公共交通能让居民获得更多就业机会，从而对就业产生直接影响。
shore: Construction near the shore should be carefully controlled to protect coastal habitats from permanent damage.
应严格管控岸边的建设活动，以保护沿海栖息地免受永久性破坏。
rescue: Coastal communities need well-equipped teams to rescue residents when severe flooding blocks roads and damages homes.
沿海社区需要装备精良的队伍，在严重洪灾阻断道路、损坏房屋时营救居民。
smooth: Clear communication between departments is essential for a smooth transition to a new working system.
部门之间清晰的沟通对于顺利过渡到新的工作制度至关重要。
cheque-check: Although digital payments are increasingly common, some businesses still accept a cheque from customers.
尽管数字支付日益普及，一些企业仍接受顾客用支票付款。
container: Reusable food containers can reduce household waste when people use them instead of disposable packaging.
人们用可重复使用的食品容器代替一次性包装，可以减少家庭垃圾。
ban: Governments should ban misleading advertisements that encourage consumers to purchase products with unproven health benefits.
政府应禁止诱导消费者购买健康功效未经证实的产品的误导性广告。
portrait: The documentary offers a compelling portrait of rural life as younger generations move to urban areas.
这部纪录片生动描绘了年轻一代迁往城市背景下的乡村生活。
tap: Universities can tap local expertise to develop practical solutions to environmental problems affecting nearby communities.
大学可以利用当地的专业知识，为影响周边社区的环境问题制定切实可行的解决方案。
pony: Supervised pony riding can help children develop confidence while teaching them how to care responsibly for animals.
在指导下骑矮种马可以帮助儿童建立信心，同时教会他们负责任地照顾动物。
infinitive: Understanding when to use an infinitive helps language learners express intentions and purposes more accurately.
理解何时使用不定式，有助于语言学习者更准确地表达意图和目的。
protection: Stronger environmental laws are essential for the protection of endangered species and their natural habitats.
更严格的环境法律对于保护濒危物种及其自然栖息地至关重要。
suburb: Reliable public transport can help residents of distant suburbs reach employment opportunities in the city centre.
可靠的公共交通可以帮助远郊居民前往市中心就业。
property: Understanding the thermal properties of building materials helps architects design homes that require less heating.
了解建筑材料的热学性能，有助于建筑师设计供暖需求更低的住宅。
introduction: The introduction of electric buses could reduce air pollution in densely populated urban areas.
引入电动公交车可以减少人口密集城区的空气污染。
ribbon: During community celebrations, residents decorate public spaces with colourful ribbons to create a welcoming atmosphere.
社区庆典期间，居民用彩色丝带装饰公共空间，营造亲切宜人的氛围。
pity: It is a pity that many historic buildings are demolished before their cultural value is properly assessed.
许多历史建筑的文化价值尚未得到充分评估就被拆除，实在令人遗憾。
eastern: Improved railway connections could help eastern regions attract investment and reduce economic differences within the country.
改善铁路连接有助于东部地区吸引投资，缩小国内经济差距。
scooter: Shared electric scooter schemes may reduce short car journeys if cities provide safe routes and suitable parking areas.
如果城市提供安全路线和合适的停车区域，共享电动滑板车项目可能减少短途驾车出行。
bunch: When passengers bunch together near train doors, boarding becomes slower and less comfortable for everyone.
当乘客聚集在列车门附近时，上车速度会变慢，所有人的乘车体验也会变差。
sensible: Investing in preventive healthcare is a sensible way to reduce pressure on public hospitals over time.
投资预防性医疗是逐步减轻公立医院压力的明智之举。
confuse: Public health messages can confuse audiences when experts use technical language without explaining its meaning.
专家使用术语却不解释其含义时，公共卫生信息可能会让受众感到困惑。
furry: Many furry mammals depend on dense coats to maintain body temperature in extremely cold environments.
许多毛茸茸的哺乳动物依靠浓密的皮毛，在极寒环境中维持体温。
athlete: Young athletes need balanced training programmes that protect their health while allowing them to pursue sporting excellence.
年轻运动员需要均衡的训练计划，在追求卓越运动表现的同时保护健康。
minibus: A community minibus can help older residents reach essential services in areas with limited public transport.
在公共交通有限的地区，社区小巴可以帮助老年居民前往提供基本服务的场所。
outdoor: Regular outdoor activities can improve children's physical health while helping them develop an appreciation of nature.
定期开展户外活动可以改善儿童的身体健康，同时培养他们对自然的欣赏。
curious: Teachers can encourage curious students to explore scientific questions through practical experiments rather than memorisation alone.
教师可以鼓励求知欲强的学生通过动手实验探索科学问题，而不只是死记硬背。
sweetheart: Many older adults maintain strong emotional connections with sweethearts they first met during their school years.
许多年长者与学生时代结识的恋人仍保持着深厚的感情联系。
term: The term sustainability describes meeting present needs without limiting the opportunities available to future generations.
可持续性这一术语指满足当代需求，同时不限制后代可获得的机会。
cosy: Small libraries can provide cosy spaces where residents read, relax, and build connections with their neighbours.
小型图书馆可以提供舒适的空间，让居民阅读、放松并与邻里建立联系。
wage: Raising the minimum wage may improve living standards, but small businesses could face higher operating costs.
提高最低工资可能改善生活水平，但小企业可能面临更高的经营成本。
scare: Misleading reports about food safety can scare consumers and damage public confidence in local producers.
有关食品安全的误导性报道可能吓到消费者，并损害公众对本地生产商的信任。
disappoint: Public transport improvements may disappoint commuters if services remain unreliable despite substantial investment in new vehicles.
尽管大量资金投入了新车辆，若服务仍不可靠，公共交通的改善可能会让通勤者失望。
annoyed: Residents often become annoyed when construction noise continues late into the evening without prior warning.
如果施工噪声持续到深夜且事先没有通知，居民往往会感到恼火。
developing: Developing economies often need sustained investment in education and infrastructure to improve living standards.
发展中经济体往往需要持续投资教育和基础设施，以提高生活水平。
graduate: Many recent graduates struggle to find employment that matches their qualifications in an increasingly competitive labour market.
在竞争日益激烈的劳动力市场中，许多应届毕业生难以找到符合自身资历的工作。
advertising: Advertising can influence consumer choices, which is why campaigns aimed at children require careful regulation.
广告会影响消费者的选择，因此针对儿童的广告活动需要受到严格监管。
research: Research into renewable energy can help governments develop cleaner and more reliable sources of electricity.
对可再生能源的研究可以帮助政府开发更清洁、更可靠的电力来源。
turning: Poor visibility at this turning increases the risk of accidents for cyclists and other road users.
这个转弯处视野不佳，增加了骑车者和其他道路使用者发生事故的风险。
dormitory: Living in a university dormitory can help new students build friendships and adjust to campus life.
住在大学宿舍可以帮助新生建立友谊，并适应校园生活。
chain: Large supermarket chains can offer lower prices, but their expansion may threaten small independent shops.
大型连锁超市可以提供更低的价格，但其扩张可能威胁独立小商店。
tiring: Long and tiring commutes can reduce workers' productivity and leave them with less time for family activities.
漫长而累人的通勤会降低员工的工作效率，也会减少他们参与家庭活动的时间。
structure: A clear essay structure helps readers follow complex arguments and understand the writer's main conclusions.
清晰的文章结构有助于读者理解复杂的论证，把握作者的主要结论。
desert: As desert areas expand, nearby farming communities face increasing pressure on their water supplies and agricultural land.
随着荒漠地区扩张，附近的农业社区在供水和耕地方面面临越来越大的压力。
relation: Researchers are examining the relation between access to green spaces and mental health in urban communities.
研究人员正在考察城市社区中绿地可及性与心理健康之间的关系。
league: A local sports league can strengthen community ties by bringing together players from different social backgrounds.
地方体育联赛可以让不同社会背景的球员聚在一起，从而加强社区联系。
dryer: Using a clothesline instead of an electric dryer can lower household energy consumption and reduce monthly bills.
用晾衣绳代替电烘干机，可以降低家庭能耗并减少每月账单支出。
seller: Online marketplaces should require each seller to provide accurate product information and clear policies for returns.
网络交易平台应要求每个卖家提供准确的产品信息和明确的退货政策。
calm: A calm classroom atmosphere can help students concentrate and feel more confident about asking questions.
平静的课堂氛围有助于学生集中注意力，也让他们更有信心提问。
depressed: Investment in public transport can connect economically depressed areas with employment opportunities and essential services.
投资公共交通可以让经济萧条地区的居民获得就业机会和基本服务。
brilliant: Brilliant teachers can inspire students to explore difficult subjects with confidence and genuine curiosity.
出色的教师能激励学生带着信心和真正的好奇心探索难学的科目。
instrument: Learning a musical instrument can strengthen concentration and encourage cooperation among children from different backgrounds.
学习乐器可以增强专注力，并促进不同背景的儿童之间的合作。
fiance: Moving abroad with a fiance can require careful planning around employment, housing, and future family responsibilities.
与未婚夫一起移居海外，可能需要围绕就业、住房和未来的家庭责任仔细规划。
jet: Replacing older passenger jets with more efficient aircraft could reduce fuel consumption across the aviation industry.
用效率更高的飞机替换老旧客机，可以降低整个航空业的燃料消耗。
crash: Financial markets can crash when investors suddenly lose confidence in the stability of the economy.
当投资者突然对经济的稳定性失去信心时，金融市场可能暴跌。
fancy: Some tourists prefer simple local accommodation to fancy hotels because it offers more opportunities for cultural exchange.
一些游客更喜欢简朴的当地住宿，而非豪华酒店，因为前者提供更多文化交流机会。
protest: Citizens may protest against environmental policies that fail to protect local forests and water supplies.
公民可能会抗议那些未能保护当地森林和水源的环境政策。
prisoner: Providing prisoners with education and vocational training may improve their chances of finding employment after release.
为囚犯提供教育和职业培训，可能提高他们获释后找到工作的机会。
due: When tuition fees are due, some students struggle to cover both educational expenses and basic living costs.
学费到期应缴时，一些学生难以同时承担教育支出和基本生活费用。
astronaut: Astronauts conduct experiments in space that help scientists understand how the human body responds to weightlessness.
宇航员在太空中开展实验，帮助科学家了解人体对失重的反应。
surround: Uncertainty continues to surround the proposed transport scheme, making it difficult for local businesses to plan ahead.
拟议中的交通方案仍存在不确定性，使当地企业难以提前规划。
rely: Communities that rely heavily on tourism may face economic difficulties when visitor numbers suddenly decline.
高度依赖旅游业的社区，在游客数量骤降时可能面临经济困难。
salty: Eating salty snacks frequently can contribute to high blood pressure, increasing the risk of cardiovascular disease.
经常吃咸味零食可能导致高血压，增加患心血管疾病的风险。
apologize: Companies should apologize promptly for service failures and explain what steps they will take to prevent further problems.
企业应及时为服务失误道歉，并说明将采取哪些措施来防止问题再次发生。
foreigner: Language courses can help foreigners participate more fully in community life and access essential public services.
语言课程可以帮助外国人更充分地参与社区生活，并获得必要的公共服务。
engaged: Students who are actively engaged in classroom discussions often develop stronger communication and critical thinking skills.
积极参与课堂讨论的学生往往能培养更强的沟通和批判性思维能力。
throughout: Reliable internet access throughout rural areas is essential for reducing inequalities in education and employment.
在农村地区全面提供可靠的互联网接入，对减少教育和就业方面的不平等至关重要。
fool: Misleading advertisements can fool consumers into buying products that offer little practical benefit.
误导性广告可能诱使消费者购买几乎没有实际用处的产品。
suit: Flexible working hours suit employees who need to balance professional responsibilities with family commitments.
弹性工作时间适合需要兼顾工作职责与家庭责任的员工。
time-off: Providing paid time off can improve employee wellbeing and reduce stress in the workplace.
提供带薪休假可以改善员工身心健康，减轻工作压力。
transfer: Governments should support the transfer of clean technology to regions that still depend heavily on fossil fuels.
政府应支持向仍高度依赖化石燃料的地区转移清洁技术。
romantic: Advertisements often present a romantic image of rural life while ignoring limited services and employment opportunities.
广告常把乡村生活描绘得很美好，却忽视了服务和就业机会不足的问题。
dot: Small villages dot the coastline, attracting visitors who prefer quieter alternatives to crowded seaside resorts.
小村庄散布在海岸线上，吸引了那些偏爱宁静而非拥挤海滨度假区的游客。
growth: Governments should balance economic growth with environmental protection to ensure that rising prosperity does not exhaust natural resources.
政府应平衡经济增长与环境保护，确保日益繁荣的经济不会耗尽自然资源。
tale: Traditional tales can preserve cultural values while helping children explore complex emotions through memorable characters.
传统故事既能传承文化价值观，也能通过令人难忘的角色帮助儿童探索复杂情感。
previously: Online courses now provide educational opportunities for people who previously had limited access to universities.
在线课程如今为那些以前难以接受大学教育的人提供了学习机会。
stain: Manufacturers are developing fabrics that resist stains, potentially reducing the water and energy required for washing.
制造商正在开发防污面料，这有望减少洗涤所需的水和能源。
previous: Previous studies suggest that regular physical activity can improve concentration and academic performance among school children.
先前的研究表明，经常运动能提高学龄儿童的专注力和学习成绩。
rat: Proper waste management helps control rat populations and reduces health risks in densely populated neighbourhoods.
妥善管理垃圾有助于控制鼠群数量，并降低人口密集社区的健康风险。
vegetarian: Providing vegetarian meals in school canteens can accommodate different dietary preferences and reduce environmental impacts.
学校食堂提供素食可以满足不同的饮食偏好，并减少对环境的影响。
tan: Although a tan is sometimes considered attractive, prolonged exposure to sunlight increases the risk of skin damage.
虽然晒成棕褐色有时被认为很有吸引力，但长时间日晒会增加皮肤受损的风险。
diving: Diving tourism can support coastal economies, provided operators protect marine habitats and teach visitors responsible behaviour.
潜水旅游可以促进沿海经济，前提是经营者保护海洋栖息地并教导游客负责任地行动。
greet: Visitors are greeted by trained volunteers who explain the museum's collection and help them find their way.
受过培训的志愿者迎接参观者，介绍博物馆的藏品并为他们指路。
brochure: University brochures can help prospective students compare courses, accommodation options, and the facilities available on campus.
大学宣传册可以帮助有意申请的学生比较课程、住宿选择及校园设施。
ladybird: Ladybirds can help farmers control certain crop pests, reducing the need for chemical pesticides.
瓢虫可以帮助农民控制某些农作物害虫，从而减少化学杀虫剂的使用。
sleeve: Workers should keep loose sleeves away from moving machinery to reduce the risk of workplace injuries.
工人应让宽松的袖子远离运转中的机器，以降低工伤风险。
signal: Increasing investment in renewable energy may signal a government's commitment to reducing its dependence on fossil fuels.
增加可再生能源投资，可能表明政府致力于减少对化石燃料的依赖。
examination: A detailed examination of local housing conditions can help governments identify communities that need urgent support.
对当地住房条件进行详细调查，可以帮助政府找出急需援助的社区。
cardboard: Replacing plastic packaging with recycled cardboard can reduce waste and encourage more sustainable consumption.
用再生硬纸板替代塑料包装可以减少废弃物，并促进更可持续的消费。
responsible: Governments are responsible for ensuring that all children have access to safe and affordable education.
政府有责任确保所有儿童都能接受安全且负担得起的教育。
electronic: Electronic health records can help doctors share information efficiently, but strong safeguards are needed to protect patient privacy.
电子健康档案能帮助医生高效共享信息，但必须采取有力措施保护患者隐私。
fahrenheit: International weather reports may provide temperatures in both Fahrenheit and Celsius to serve different audiences.
国际天气预报可能同时提供华氏和摄氏温度，以满足不同受众的需要。
approximately: Approximately half of the households surveyed reported using public transport at least once a week.
受访家庭中，约有一半表示每周至少使用一次公共交通。
corridor: Wildlife corridors allow animals to move safely between habitats that roads and urban development have separated.
野生动物廊道使动物能够在被道路和城市开发分隔的栖息地之间安全迁移。
tick: Participants should tick the appropriate boxes to indicate how frequently they use public transport.
参与者应在相应方框内打钩，说明自己使用公共交通的频率。
hurricane: Coastal cities need stronger flood defences and reliable warning systems to protect residents when a hurricane approaches.
沿海城市需要更坚固的防洪设施和可靠的预警系统，以在飓风来临时保护居民。
bible: Studying the Bible can help students understand religious references in European literature and visual art.
研读《圣经》可以帮助学生理解欧洲文学和视觉艺术中的宗教典故。
warning: Effective flood warning systems allow residents to leave dangerous areas before roads become impossible to use.
有效的洪水预警系统能让居民在道路无法通行前撤离危险区域。
retell: Asking students to retell a story in their own words can improve comprehension and speaking skills.
让学生用自己的话复述故事，可以提高理解能力和口语技能。
loudspeaker: Public transport stations use loudspeaker systems to communicate urgent safety information to large numbers of passengers.
公共交通车站利用扩音系统向大量乘客传达紧急安全信息。
net: The company increased its net profit by reducing energy consumption rather than raising prices for customers.
这家公司通过减少能源消耗而非提高售价来增加净利润。
delivery: The growing demand for home delivery has increased traffic congestion in many urban neighbourhoods.
不断增长的送货上门需求加剧了许多城市社区的交通拥堵。
campus: Providing affordable accommodation on campus can help students spend less time commuting and more time studying.
提供价格合理的校内住宿可以帮助学生减少通勤时间，增加学习时间。
similarity: Despite their geographical distance, the two regions show striking similarities in traditional farming methods.
尽管地理位置相距遥远，这两个地区的传统耕作方式却有着惊人的相似之处。
weapon: Stricter controls on weapon sales may help governments improve public safety and reduce violent crime.
更严格地管控武器销售可能有助于政府改善公共安全并减少暴力犯罪。
personally: Personally, I believe that public libraries remain essential because they provide free access to reliable information.
